meta.title: Ledger batch reconciliation: staged checks and durable audit

messages.label: Start batch
messages.note: Batch B-042 covers account A-17 for the previous business day.

messages.label: Load opening balance
messages.note: Read the last signed closing balance before processing any entries.

messages.label: Opening balance
messages.note: The starting balance is 1250.00 and its revision is R-100.

messages.label: Read deposits
messages.note: Deposits are selected by booking date and stable transaction identifiers.

messages.label: Deposit records
messages.note: Deposit D-11 adds 250.00; deposit D-12 adds 100.00.

messages.label: Read withdrawals
messages.note: Withdrawals use the same day boundary as deposits.

messages.label: Withdrawal records
messages.note: Withdrawal W-21 removes 80.00; withdrawal W-22 removes 20.00.

messages.label: Read adjustments
messages.note: Adjustment J-31 adds a 5.00 fee reversal approved by finance.

messages.label: Adjustment record
messages.note: Approval AP-7 is attached to J-31 and must remain in the audit.

messages.label: Check duplicate IDs
messages.note: Duplicate transaction IDs stop publication rather than being silently skipped.

messages.label: IDs unique
messages.note: D-11, D-12, W-21, W-22 and J-31 are distinct.

messages.label: Check revision R-100
messages.note: A changed opening revision requires a complete batch restart.

messages.label: Revision unchanged
messages.note: The opening revision remains R-100 throughout the calculation.

messages.label: Write candidate close
messages.note: The proposed closing balance is 1505.00, not yet externally visible.

messages.label: Candidate staged
messages.note: Candidate C-42 is staged under batch B-042 with all five transactions.

messages.label: Commit audit and close
messages.note: Audit A-42 and the closing balance are committed atomically.

messages.label: Commit confirmed
messages.note: Closing revision R-101 binds balance 1505.00 and audit A-42.

messages.label: Batch complete
messages.note: The operator receives B-042, R-101 and A-42 for later investigation.
